articles.title: Housing starts up 5.6% in 2025 from 2024
articles.summary: CNW Group: Housing starts up 5.6% in 2025 from 2024. Nationally, the housing starts total for all areas in Canada in 2025 was 259,028, the fifth highest annual total on record and up 5.6% compared to 2024 (245,367). Actual 2025 housing starts in centres of 10,000 population and over were up 6%, with 241,171 units recorded, compared to 227,697 in 2024, according to Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC).
